Are you looking for a fun and varied logistics job in Eindhoven? At the modern warehouse of Rhenus, you’ll work in a friendly team where a good atmosphere and collaboration come first. Whether you start as an order picker, packer, or in the inbound department, you’ll have plenty of opportunities to develop and grow. Do you speak Dutch or English and have logistics experience? Then you’ll fit right in with this team of great colleagues. Apply today!

Employment agency Manpower is looking for logistics employees for Rhenus Warehousing Solutions in Eindhoven.

In this varied role, you’ll work in the warehouse and help ensure everything runs smoothly together with your team. Your tasks include:

    - Picking and packing orders
    
- Assisting with inbound of incoming goods
    
- Performing VAS tasks, such as preparing products for shipment
    
- Operating an EPT to move goods safely
    
- Contributing to a clean and well-organized work environment

What's in it for you

    - The gross salary ranges from €15.00 to €15.59 per hour.
    
- Travel allowance of €0.23 per kilometer (up to €16.10 per day)
    
- Full-time job of 40 hours per week
    
- Temporary contract via Manpower (with possibility of direct hire upon good performance)
    
- Development opportunities through the Manpower Academy (more than 200 online courses)
    
- Pension accrual via Manpower
    
- Pleasant working atmosphere and internal growth opportunities

    - Good command of the English or Dutch language
    
- Willingness to apply for a Certificate of Conduct (VOG)
    
- At least six months of previous experience in logistics
    
- Availability of 40 hours per week

An EPT certificate is a plus. Don’t have one? No problem – you can obtain it through us.

Is this your new job and do you want to be considered? Then apply today before the vacancy closes, and Manpower will contact you within two working days!

As a Mechanical Assembly Technician, you will work on the assembly of high-quality machines and technical systems used within the high-tech industry. From the first components to a fully operational machine, you play an important role throughout the entire build process. Together with colleagues from different technical disciplines, you ensure that every machine is assembled accurately, tested thoroughly and prepared for delivery. No project is the same: one day you may be assembling complex modules in the workshop, while the next day you may support installation or commissioning activities at a customer location. Your responsibilities include: Assembling machines, modules and technical installations. Installing and connecting mechanical and electrical components. Testing machines and checking functionality and quality. Reading and applying technical drawings and work instructions. Identifying and resolving technical issues during assembly. Contributing ideas to improve assembly processes. Working closely with colleagues to successfully complete projects. Arbeidsvoorwaarden You will join an innovative organization where technology, craftsmanship and personal development are key. You will work on challenging projects within high-tech machine building and have the opportunity to continuously expand your technical skills. We offer: A competitive salary based on your knowledge and experience. 25 vacation days and additional ADV days. A solid pension scheme. Travel allowance. Training opportunities and possibilities for professional growth. Working with modern tools and the latest technologies. A collaborative working environment with skilled and enthusiastic colleagues. The opportunity for a permanent contract after a successful probation period. You work accurately, take responsibility for your work and enjoy collaborating with others to

deliver high-quality solutions. You have: A technical MBO-level education, preferably in Mechatronics, Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering or a similar field. Experience as a Mechanical Assembly Technician, Machine Builder or in a similar technical role. Experience reading technical drawings. Strong mechanical skills; electrical knowledge is an advantage. A structured and quality-focused approach to your work. Good command of the Dutch and/or English language. A proactive attitude and a team-oriented mindset. Hier kom je te werken Through us, you will join an innovative organization active in high-tech machine building. The company develops, builds and delivers advanced machines and technical systems for leading companies within the technology industry. You will work in a modern environment where craftsmanship, innovation and collaboration come together. There is plenty of room for personal development, and you will have the opportunity to contribute to projects where you can see the direct impact of your work.
